name: project-stats
description: Example plugin: summarises the current project (asset, timeline and clip counts) from project.json.
install: Copy this directory to <config dir>/plugins/project-stats, then enable it: cinvar.plugins.set_enabled {id: "org.cinvar.example.project-stats", enabled: true}.

tools.name: stats
tools.description: Count assets, timelines, tracks and clips in the open project. Read-only; writes nothing.
